name: Raj Aryan
title: Backend Developer | AI, ML & GenAI | MCA @ JNU
summary: MCA student and backend developer actively learning AI, ML, and GenAI. Recognized nationally for structural context engineering (First Runner-Up, Promptverse 2.0). Passionate about building robust, cost-efficient AI applications. Valued for foundational problem-solving, writing easy-to-maintain code, and clear technical communication.

projects.title: MindSpace | AI-Powered Mental Wellness Platform
bullets: Built "Mimi," an AI chatbot providing context-aware mental health support, using a custom RAG pipeline and Pinecone for vector storage.
Designed a hybrid database (MySQL & MongoDB) to guarantee ACID compliance for user data while scaling chat logs for 100+ concurrent sessions.
Constrained LLM outputs exclusively to verified psychological datasets, mitigating hallucinations and ensuring medically safe user interactions.
Secured a Top 100 finish among 500+ teams and 3,000+ participants.

projects.title: IntelliDocs | AI Document Analysis System
bullets: Launched on AWS Lightsail, acquiring 50+ signups, engineering a secure tunneling architecture to bypass free-tier hardware constraints by routing heavy LLM inference to local compute.

Architected a robust data pipeline utilizing PyMuPDF for text extraction and Cloudinary for file management, converting documents into vector embeddings stored in TiDB alongside page-level metadata for precise context engineering.
Automated document summarization using Local LLMs (Ollama), efficiently processing complex files while entirely eliminating external API costs.
Coordinated the MCA placement drive, acting as the primary liaison between students, faculty, and corporate recruiters.
Researched prospective companies to effectively match industry hiring requirements with student profiles.
Managed official email correspondence and drafted formal requests, ensuring clear professional communication.
